queries_run: AMD 10-K 2026 top customer revenue concentration percentage
AMD customer concentration risk disclosure distributor 2026
OpenAI Meta credit rating balance sheet financial stress 2026
AMD Instinct OpenAI Meta deal bankruptcy downgrade guidance cut 2026

findings.claim: AMD 10-K (FY2025, filed 2026-02-04) discloses no single customer accounted for 10% or more of consolidated net revenue in fiscal 2025 or fiscal 2024, an improvement from FY2023 when one customer accounted for 18% of consolidated net revenue.
findings.source: AMD Form 10-K for fiscal year ended 2025-12-27, SEC EDGAR (amd-20251227.htm)

findings.claim: AMD's forward customer base is concentrating around a small number of AI hyperscalers: AMD and Meta signed a 5-year, up-to-$60B, 6GW Instinct GPU supply agreement (with AMD issuing Meta a performance-based warrant for 160M shares), and combined with the OpenAI 6GW agreement AMD has ~12GW of committed deployments; these agreements are multi-year and milestone-based, meaning most of the associated revenue is not yet contracted, shipped, or paid.
findings.source: CNBC / Tom's Hardware / AMD IR press release on AMD-Meta strategic partnership

findings.claim: OpenAI, a counterparty to AMD's Instinct GPU supply agreement, reported a Q1 2026 net loss of $21.3B, carries roughly $665B in long-term compute purchase commitments not reflected as balance-sheet debt, and faces a projected financing gap of about $130B over the next two years.
findings.source: TradingKey / IFR (International Financing Review) reporting on OpenAI Q1 2026 financials

findings.claim: Despite tripling its debt load in a single month (including $26B in debt financing from Blue Owl/PIMCO for a Louisiana AI data center), Moody's (2026-07-24) said Meta still retains one of the strongest corporate balance sheets and its investment-grade rating is not under imminent threat, even as Moody's flagged 'unprecedented' AI spending as a broader credit-quality risk across hyperscalers.

S&P Global downgraded Oracle's credit rating from BBB to BBB- (one notch above junk), explicitly naming OpenAI as a 'key credit risk' for Oracle due to Oracle's large compute-supply exposure to OpenAI — illustrating rating-agency concern about OpenAI's counterparty credit quality that is also relevant to AMD's own OpenAI compute agreement.
findings.source: the-decoder.com / TradingKey reporting on S&P Global Oracle downgrade

customer_concentration_credit.note: AMD's disclosed 10-K customer concentration (≥10% revenue) has actually improved (none in FY24/FY25 vs 18% in FY23). The more material forward-looking concentration risk is qualitative/undisclosed-by-AMD: reliance on OpenAI and Meta for future Instinct GPU revenue under multi-year, milestone-based, largely uncontracted agreements, combined with public credit-stress signals around OpenAI specifically (not Meta, which remains strong per Moody's).
